protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. MiniServ simplifies the requested path, then tests it against the default unauth list before session authentication. The rule ^[A-Za-z0-9\-/_]+\.conf$ matches module-relative paths such as /nis/nisupdate.conf; the match sets unauth=4, clears the authenticated user, and later serves the resolved file from the Webmin root as a non-CGI file. CVE-2026-56021 remains PUBLISHED and describes this unauthenticated module-directory .conf disclosure.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed. fc1c1b243f7973c222c0b3a2d1f0ab45af485397 is the first surviving Git object that adds miniserv.pl, including both the .conf unauth rule and its consuming matcher. The 2009 underscore edit and 2026 miniserv-lib.pl extraction are later modifications, not first writes.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. The BIC has the single immediate parent 27d3d6cb9738150bc944ae17ebe8fc8a6396012e; that parent has no miniserv.pl, while the BIC adds the file and vulnerable mechanism.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed as not applicable. The BIC is a bulk initial check-in, but its parent is present and verifiable and the clone exposes no finer public member for the first-written miniserv.pl mechanism. Later history does not supply an earlier introducer.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: Confirmed. The BIC is an ancestor of tag 2.641 and HEAD, CVE.org marks version * affected, and the vulnerable rule is present in tag 2.641.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: Confirmed as absent. The cited 2.641 release changes unrelated trusted-proxy, SSL-header, and login-redirect code; it retains the .conf unauth rule and is not a fixed release for CVE-2026-56021.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state: Verified unpatched. Current HEAD 19206d485a7d2ea425f5f60b82be996f6d22912b still contains the rule and matcher. CISA CSAF VA-26-169-02 version 2.0.0 lists all versions known affected with remediation no_fix_planned; no direct fix commit is evidenced.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: Confirmed. The BIC object is dated 2007-04-12, authored and committed by Jamie Cameron <jcameron@webmin.com>, with message 'Initial checkin of Webmin' and no AI/bot marker or attribution trailer. The NOT_AI judgment relies on this BIC only.
